About

Clarity in Every System.

Zyvex Tech is a consulting, implementation, and performance marketing firm working at the intersection of process, ecommerce, and demand generation. We serve founders and growing businesses around the world, from a first Shopify store to a full funnel rebuild. Zyvex Tech helps businesses define clear processes and technology goals, then builds and runs the systems that make them real: structured consulting, hands-on Shopify implementation, and performance marketing that turns traffic into revenue. We stay close to what we build, because a system that isn’t maintained is a system that quietly stops working.

About the Founder

Syed Fidel Shaan.

Founder & CEO

Syed Fidel Shaan founded Zyvex Tech on a simple observation: most businesses don’t need more advice, they need it built, launched, and run. He works directly with founders around the world, not as a distant consultant, but as someone in the build with them, from the first funnel audit to the tools running unattended.

His approach treats consulting and implementation as one discipline: a process is only as good as the system built to run it, and a system is only as good as the process it was designed around.

The Team

The Team Behind It.

A small, senior team in Calicut working directly with the founders and operators who hire us. The person who audits your funnel is the person who builds the store and runs the campaigns. No handover to a junior bench, and nobody between you and the work.

What the team covers

Consulting & Audit

Funnel and process audits, systems design, and the prioritized plan every engagement starts from.

Shopify Development

Store builds, theme customization, checkout configuration, migrations and app work.

Performance Marketing

Meta and paid campaigns run as an ongoing system: structure, audiences and creative testing.

SEO

Technical and on-page SEO, keyword and content strategy, and Shopify-specific search work.

Retention & Automation

Email and WhatsApp flows, re-engagement and the integrations behind them, so follow-up happens without anyone remembering to send it.

Support & Training

Handover, documentation and ongoing support, so the system keeps running after we hand over the keys.

Vision & Mission

What Drives Everything We Build.

Our Vision / 01

To be the team a business calls before it buys the software: the partner that works out what is actually needed, builds it, and stays to run it.

Most businesses are not short of tools. They are short of someone who will look at the business first and say plainly which of those tools they need and which they can skip. We want that to be the normal way growing businesses buy technology, not the exception.

Our Mission / 02

To consult before we recommend, recommend honestly, implement it ourselves, and support what we build, so a business ends up with a stack that fits it rather than one it has to grow into.

We start with your business model, your product and your goals. From there we scope the stack, build it, and stay on to maintain and support it, particularly for Shopify clients, where the store is the revenue and ongoing support is the whole point.

Core Values

The Standards We Build Around.

Consult Before We Recommend

We learn the business model, the product and the goal before naming a single tool. Then we say plainly what you need and what you don't.

Execution, Not Just Advice

Every recommendation ships. We build, configure, and integrate the systems ourselves. Strategy is only real once it's implemented.

Decisions Backed by Data

Funnel audits and CRO work start with what the numbers actually show, not assumptions about what should be converting.

Built to Convert

Every store, campaign, landing page, and funnel we implement is judged on one thing: does it move a visitor to a decision.

Maintained, Not Just Delivered

We stay on to maintain and support what we build, especially Shopify stores, where the site is the revenue and a system nobody maintains quietly stops working.
